mapper.select: select * from internship_stage_settings order by stage_no asc
select * from internship_stage_settings where stage_no = #{stageNo} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into internship_stage_settings ( stage_no, stage_name, selection_start_date, selection_end_date, change_deadline, internship_start_date, internship_end_date, confirmation_deadline, report_cycle, report_deadline, appraisal_deadline, enabled, version, updater_id, updater_name, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{stageNo}, #{stageName}, #{selectionStartDate}, #{selectionEndDate}, #{changeDeadline}, #{internshipStartDate}, #{internshipEndDate}, #{confirmationDeadline}, #{reportCycle}, #{reportDeadline}, #{appraisalDeadline}, coalesce(#{enabled}, 1), coalesce(#{version}, 0), #{updaterId}, #{updaterName}, now(), now() )
